new_senses.rationale: One autobiographical occurrence after return from military service names the spouse with ʕam. A completed marriage is clear; II Detransitive filing is provisional because an alternative loan paradigm is possible.

added_examples.translation: And after I came back from Turkish corvée, from military service, I espoused my spousal unit, Yəldəz, and so forth.
